title: Realtime Data Quality Audit

findings.issue: Timestamp property mismatch: fusedData uses "timestamp" but UI reads "fused.lastUpdate"
findings.impact: Last Updated timestamp always shows "No Realtime Data" or "Unknown" instead of actual time
findings.fix: Change fused.lastUpdate → fused.timestamp in both places

findings.issue: Lines with ODPT mapping but no API response get status="normal" (assumed normal)
findings.impact: When ODPT API is unavailable/down, all covered lines show "On Time" instead of "No Realtime Data"
findings.location: js/data-fusion.js fuseLine(): LINE_TO_OPERATOR check returns {status:"normal"} when apiInfo is null but operator exists
findings.fix: Distinguish between "has ODPT mapping" and "has live data" — use no_odpt when apiInfo is null despite having mapping

findings.issue: Rinkai operator has no ODPT endpoint in LINE_TO_OPERATOR
findings.impact: Rinkai line (東京臨海高速鉄道りんかい線) always shows no_odpt status
findings.fix: Add Rinkai operator endpoint OR map it to an existing operator if data is shared

findings.issue: Status detection relies on Japanese text keyword matching
findings.impact: False positives/negatives if ODPT returns unexpected text format
findings.fix: No fix needed — this is a known limitation of the ODPT API response format

findings.issue: updateOdptData function exists but is never called in the runtime
findings.impact: External code cannot inject ODPT delay data into DataFusion
findings.location: js/data-fusion.js line 210: updateOdptData defined but no callers found
findings.fix: Not a bug — may be a dead API or intended for future use

recommendation: Fix F-001 (timestamp bug) immediately. F-002 is a design choice that may need review. F-003 is a data gap.
